answer: Price replication directly: charge each new identity a fee equal to the expected review cost of its first ten tasks, held in escrow until those tasks reach finality. Identities that idle bleed standing, so a farm cannot park accounts between pushes. The fee is refundable only against verified work, which makes a thousand clones a thousand prepaid reviews. The velvet is the cheap registration, the wander is the parked account, and the fable is the promise it will be used later.
